Short summary: Lost to internal self-host decision. CTO (Carlos Vega) explicit: 'We get more control and predictable cost if we run vLLM/TGI on our infra — we can tune quantization and use TensorRT for critical low-latency paths.'

- 2025-08-12 lead created from webinar; inbound interest in hosted + dedicated.
- 2025-09-03 discovery call w/ CTO + infra lead. Interested in chat assistant for ops, embeddings for search, reranker for candidate scoring. Target p95 latency <120ms for chat; embeddings throughput 20k reqs/day.
- 2025-09-17 technical deep-dive (Ravi + SE). Discussed model variants, batching, KV cache, quantization. Provided benchmark deck and per-token cost estimates.
- 2025-10-02 security questionnaire shared (drive link). They required KMS integration, audit logs, and data residency in us-west.
- 2025-10-21 on-site demo + PoC kickoff call (Fireflies ID above). Agreed to 6-week POC on Dedicated. Provided POC success criteria: latency, cost per 1M tokens, failover behavior.
- 2025-11-10 internal infra review flagged: ability to run vLLM/TGI + TensorRT gives 3x cost upside vs hosted list price (their estimate).
- 2025-11-22 procurement pause: finance requested pause on SaaS commitments pending fiscal FY26 budget.
- 2025-12-03 final call: CTO indicates preference to self-host; vendor comparison shows internal team will build on vLLM/TGI with TensorRT optimizations. No final contract signed.
- 2025-12-10 outreach attempts after reorg; AE notes champion (Head of ML Ops) left; account becoming unresponsive. Marking closed-lost.

- CTO: 'We need cryptographic control and to own latency profiles end-to-end.'
- Head of Infra: 'If we can get 50-60% cost reduction running on spot GPUs + TensorRT kernels, finance will greenlight.'

Why lost: mixture of cost math + security/regulatory comfort with on-prem. Also internal reorg removed sponsor. Team will implement self-host stack (vLLM + TGI + TensorRT) and revisit third-party if runs into scale/ops pain.

Follow-up / nurture plan: quarterly check-ins; share new dedicated pricing and on-prem reference architecture; watch for signals: procurement re-opens, cloud residency reqs, or ops staffing shortfall.

Internal notes for AE/SE: keep short tech case studies showing how Redwood handles KMS + audit logs in Private; build one-pager comparing ops effort vs TCO for self-host at 3x scale.
